description:
Sends a PDF to one or two people for electronic signature, by email, text message, or both at once. Delivery happens IMMEDIATELY and the result is a legally binding signature, so confirm the recipient and the document with the user before calling this.

The PDF must already contain signature tags: ^S1 where signer one signs, ^I1 for initials, ^D1 for a date that fills itself, and ^S2 / ^I2 / ^D2 for a second signer. Those tags must be WHITE font or they print on the finished document. If the document has no tags this call is rejected and nothing is sent.

Calling twice with the same document and signers returns the first envelope rather than sending a second copy, so a retry is safe.

delivery.description: How to notify the signer. Texting is what Siglio is for and costs the same; ask the user if a text would be better.

document_name.description: What the signer sees it called. Defaults to the filename.

document_path.description: Full path to the tagged PDF on this machine.

idempotency_key.description: Rarely needed. One is derived from the document and signers if omitted.

signers.description: One or two signers. With two, signing is sequential: the second is not notified until the first finishes.

delivery.description: Overrides the envelope's delivery for this signer.

email.description: Required if this signer is reached by email.

phone.description: E.164 preferred, e.g. +18135550142. Required if reached by text.

name: send_for_signature
title: Send a document for signature
